# Learning notes

This public fixture contains enough structure to exercise selective Markdown reading.

## Cognitive load

An interface should keep the information needed for the current decision visible. Unrelated detail
can be retrieved later instead of occupying the same view.

### Worked example

Start with a complete example, explain the decisions, and then remove support gradually.

## Adaptive explanation

The source can stay constant while the explanation, practice, or interface changes for the task.

## Evaluation

Adaptation should be treated as a revisable hypothesis and checked against outcomes.
